title: Pack Size
description: Analyzes pack file sizes and counts to ensure content fits within platform limits. Large packs can cause download issues and slow loading times on mobile devices.

101.title: Total Size
101.description: Total size in bytes of all files in the pack, including non-content files.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the size in bytes as a number

102.title: File Count
102.description: Total number of files in the pack.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the file count as a number

103.title: Folder Count
103.description: Total number of folders in the pack.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the folder count as a number

104.title: Content Size
104.description: Total size in bytes of content files only (JSON, images, sounds, etc.), excluding system files.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the content size in bytes as a number

105.title: Content Files
105.description: Number of content files in the pack.
105.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the content file count as a number

106.title: Content Folders
106.description: Number of content folders in the pack.
106.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the content folder count as a number

401.title: Addon Size Warning
401.description: Warning when the add-on exceeds recommended size limits. Large add-ons may have issues on mobile platforms or with Realms uploads.
401.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the size that exceeds the limit

402.title: Package Size Warning
402.description: Warning when the packaged content (.mcaddon/.mcpack) exceeds recommended size limits for distribution.
402.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the package size that exceeds the limit

410.title: Zip Processing Error
410.description: Error when a zip file within the pack could not be read or processed. May indicate corruption or unsupported compression.
410.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the problematic zip file
